description: This file defines the main presentation widget 'ProjectsPage' for managing projects in a Flutter application. It displays a list of projects, allows creation, editing, and deletion with confirmation dialogues, and interacts with repositories for data operations.

classes.name: ProjectsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of projects with CRUD operations and interaction capabilities.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Opens the ProjectFormPage to create a new project.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Opens the ProjectFormPage to edit an existing project.

methods.name: _showProjectMenu
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet menu with options to edit or delete a project.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Prompts user for delete confirmation and performs delete operation for a project and related tasks.
